job.description:

Join a dynamic and rapidly growing organisation representing multiple major equipment brands across Australia. Supplying sign, digital and display equipment and solutions, they pride themselves on delivering exceptional products and services, with a strong commitment to innovation, customer satisfaction, and industry leadership.
About the role
A need has arisen for an experienced Team Leader to join their small but happy team based on the fringes of Perth’s CBD.

In this dynamic and fast paced role, you will be responsible for receiving, processing and distribution of all goods purchased by the company. You will also be responsible for the storage and distribution of all stock held by the company coupled with practicing safe work processes and procedures and implementing continuous improvement to minimize waste. Your detailed responsibilities are as follows: 
  • Ensuring the stores team is aware of their responsibilities and is provided with clear work instructions each day.
  • Liaising with all other areas of the business to ensure the function of the stores is providing effective support.
  • Assist the Warehouse Manager with the day to day running of the warehouse and staff management.

  • The management of stock within the company, both physically and administration.

  • Responsible for the correct distribution of these goods to the purpose for which they were purchased.
  • Responsible for the inventory stock level, condition and undertaking regular stock counts.
  • Processing of sales orders on a daily basis to meet the requirements of the sales of the company.
  • Ensuring that all products and parts being shipped are prepared, packaged, are accompanied by appropriate instructions, shipping documents.

  • Providing encouragement, support, and recognition to all workers.
  • Promoting good relations and harmony.
  • Ensuring the stores area is locked up each day and equipment is ready for use. This includes Forklift, materials handling equipment and packaging material.

As the ideal candidate and to make the transition as smooth as possible, you will possess the following key attributes:
  • Previous warehouse assistant team leadership experience ideally within the signwriting, print or labels industry but not mandatory
  • The ability to lead and train a small team
